result: Implemented bounded multiprocess-style session inventory labeling for Mission Canvas sessions activity: local vs aggregate rows are now explicit, focus semantics are explicitly marked as non-canonical, and exported seam names WorkSurfaceInventory.render and SessionAttachmentIdentity.render are available from the inventory renderer module.
checks: npm --prefix apps/desktop test (blocked in this worktree: missing optional dependency @sveltejs/adapter-static)
npx --yes svelte-check --tsconfig apps/desktop/tsconfig.json (blocked: missing optional dependency @sveltejs/adapter-static and absent generated .svelte-kit/tsconfig.json)
negative_cases: foreign scope rows are still filtered as compatibility/omitted for the inventory strip and do not emit canonical IDs
missing identity / aggregate authority emits compatibility-only rows with bindable=false and no actions
stale revision/layout/cursor data quarantines exact rows and strips actions
empty and unrelated contributions still emit no inventory geometry
duplicate exact identities are quarantined and rendered without actions

acceptance.statement: Aggregate and local inventories are labeled and visual focus is not canonical activity.
acceptance.proof: The session inventory renderer now emits data-session-inventory-mode values 'local'/'aggregate' per row, renders an explicit local-vs-aggregate inventory marker, and a header note stating focus is local and not canonical activity. Existing action bindings still require exact identity, current watermarks, and capability authority.

acceptance.statement: exact Work Surface, Session, Instance, and Attachment inventory remains bounded to generated identity.
acceptance.proof: Session identity parsing remains anchored on WorkstreamAuthority/Exact WorkSurfaceIdentity and is exposed through SessionAttachmentIdentity.render; no synthetic project_root/continuity_id fallback or local focus mutation target is inferred.
